hooks.name: Update implementation state before session ends
hooks.description: Reminds to update implementation-state.md with progress before the session ends, keeping the state file current for the next session.

action.prompt:
Before this session ends, update .kiro/steering/implementation-state.md to reflect:
- Any tasks that moved from "Next Up" to "In Progress" or "Completed"
- Any new files/paths created during this session added to "Key Files & Paths Created"
- Any new blockers discovered
- Update "Current Phase" if a phase boundary was crossed
This ensures the next session picks up exactly where this one left off.
